# Humans
Depending on who you ask, humans are either unremarkable or the universal standard to which everything else is compared. They have no special mechanics or notable attributes.
Even with this, most humans as of 2526 have had some level of genetic modification somewhere within their bloodlines- this includes [linktext="Felinids"link="Felinid"], as they are considered a subspecies of human.
Whether non-human species should count as citizens within human-dominated civilizations has been a long debate, for as long as the existence of other sapient species have been known.
